ov: ذكريات هو فيلم رسوم متحركة خيال علمي ياباني من إخراج كاتسوهيرو أوتومو. صدر الفيلم في 23 ديسمبر 1995.
plotEn:
Memories is a 1995 Japanese animated science fiction anthology film with Katsuhiro Otomo as executive producer, and based on three of his manga short stories. The film is composed of three shorts: Magnetic Rose (Japanese: 彼女の想いで, Hepburn: Kanojo no Omoide), directed by Studio 4°C co-founder Kōji Morimoto and written by Satoshi Kon; Stink Bomb (最臭兵器, Saishū-heiki), directed by Tensai Okamura and written by Otomo, and Cannon Fodder (大砲の街, Taihō no Machi), written and directed by Otomo himself.
